title: Packing for a Romantic City Escape
excerpt: A simple, elegant approach to packing for stylish weekend travel without overpacking.

blocks.body:
## Travel light, still feel polished
For a romantic city escape, I focus on pieces that feel effortless, elevated, and easy to repeat in new ways. Think soft layers, one strong coat, comfortable shoes, and accessories that photograph beautifully.

blocks.text: The best suitcase is the one that leaves room for spontaneity.
blocks.author: Iris

title: How I Plan Solo Trips in Europe
excerpt: My current framework for choosing destinations, stays, and experiences that feel safe, special, and worth documenting.

blocks.body:
## Start with mood, then logistics
I usually begin with how I want a place to feel. Do I want romance, drama, softness, or movement? From there I narrow the city, the neighborhood, and the stay.

title: Creating a Luxury Feel on a Short Trip
excerpt: Luxury does not always mean excess. Sometimes it means choosing one beautiful thing and building the trip around it.

blocks.body:
## Focus on one signature moment
A beautiful hotel room, a memorable dinner, or a sunrise viewpoint can shape the tone of the whole trip. I plan around one anchor experience and let everything else support it.
